verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hostable Edge Proxy explicitly designed to run the Flagsmith Engine near your servers, with server-side SDKs connecting to it directly inside your own infrastructure, keeping traffic local and serving flags even if the vendor is unreachable. This is corroborated by self-hosting docs for the full platform as well. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of offline/vendor-outage resilience and more detail on caching/fallback behavior during vendor downtime.
